summary: Mohinga is a rice noodle and fish soup from Myanmar, widely regarded as the country's national dish and a core part of Burmese cuisine. It is sold across the country by street hawkers and roadside stalls, especially in major cities. Traditionally a breakfast food, it is increasingly eaten throughout the day.
one_line: Mohinga is a Burmese rice noodle and fish soup, considered by many to be Myanmar's national dish and traditionally eaten for breakfast.
key_facts: Mohinga is a rice noodle and fish soup from Myanmar.
Mohinga is an essential part of Burmese cuisine.
Many people consider mohinga to be the national dish of Myanmar.
Mohinga is readily available in most parts of Myanmar.
In major cities, street hawkers and roadside stalls sell dozens of dishes of mohinga to locals and passers-by.
Mohinga is usually eaten for breakfast.
Today mohinga is being consumed more and more throughout the day.
